name: Infrastructure OSINT
description: Gathering and analyzing publicly available information about network infrastructure. Covers DNS enumeration, WHOIS analysis, IP/ASN mapping, certificate transparency log mining, passive DNS, subdomain discovery, and technology fingerprinting to build a comprehensive picture of a target's internet-facing footprint.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to infrastructure reconnaissance or OSINT techniques

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands core concepts of DNS, WHOIS, and IP address space; aware of passive vs. active reconnaissance distinctions
evidence: Can explain the difference between passive and active reconnaissance
Understands DNS record types and their intelligence value
Familiar with WHOIS data and its limitations

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs basic infrastructure OSINT using standard tools under supervision
evidence: Uses tools such as amass, subfinder, or dnsx for subdomain enumeration under guidance
Queries certificate transparency logs (crt.sh, Censys) to identify related domains
Performs WHOIS lookups and documents ownership relationships
Results reviewed by authorized personnel for completeness

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently conducts infrastructure OSINT and produces structured reconnaissance reports
evidence: Builds comprehensive infrastructure maps for target organizations across 3+ engagements
Correlates data from multiple sources (passive DNS, BGP, certificate logs, Shodan/Censys)
Identifies shadow IT, cloud assets, and third-party infrastructure connections
Produces structured reconnaissance reports that pass QA review

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex infrastructure mapping; develops automation; mentors junior analysts
evidence: Maps complex multi-cloud and CDN-obscured infrastructure
Develops custom automation pipelines for continuous infrastructure monitoring
Identifies non-obvious infrastructure relationships through ASN pivoting and historical data
Reviews and mentors junior staff on infrastructure OSINT methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines infrastructure OSINT methodology; develops novel techniques; trains teams
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's infrastructure OSINT methodology and toolchain
Develops novel discovery techniques or contributes to open-source OSINT tools
Publishes research on infrastructure reconnaissance methods
Trains teams on infrastructure OSINT and defines engagement standards

assessment_methods.description: Given a target organization name, produce a comprehensive infrastructure map within a defined timeframe using only passive techniques
Review infrastructure reconnaissance reports from recent engagements for completeness and accuracy
